confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of New Zealand price levels and a USD conversion at the RBA rate; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately confident. Cocktail and wine_glass were set from the local beer relationship, since direct knowledge is weaker. Accommodation is less certain: July is low season for city tourism, though ski-season demand can lift rates in some years. Ranges are roughly plus or minus 15 to 20 percent.
comparable_city_reasoning: Anchored to general New Zealand urban price levels, benchmarked against other mid-sized New Zealand cities (such as Wellington and Dunedin) and adjusted to Christchurch's mid-range position. No specific external comparable city was used.
